title: Anthropic commits $100M to train 10,000 AI engineers
narration: Anthropic just committed one hundred million dollars to train ten thousand engineers through its new Claude Frontier Academy. This is not a normal online certification. Nominated software engineers start with an in-person deployment simulation, then spend twelve weeks leading a real Claude project inside their own company. The first cohorts include engineers from Accenture, Bain, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk. The bigger idea is that enterprise AI may be bottlenecked less by model access, and more by people who can safely turn these systems into production workflows. For now, participation is company-nominated, not open enrollment.
